# The Q-039 link with `txn_guid:` and no `txn_split_guid:` beside it.
#
# The transaction has one side that is not the bank, so there is nothing to
# choose between and naming the split adds nothing. This is what a person
# writes by hand.
#
# It is the way that failed worst. The importer measured the parked
# split's 139.00 CAD against the invoice's 100.00 USD, called the difference an
# overpayment and offered `prepayment: 39.00` — thirty-nine of nothing, the two
# figures being in different currencies and the CAD one about to be discarded.
#
# What this fixture produces: the same book as
# a_payment_giving_the_parked_split.txt — the receivable carrying −100.00 USD
# in the invoice's lot, the entry quoted in USD, no CAD and no rate.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
invoice "INV-USD-001"
  customer_id: "C-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
    memo: "Invoice INV-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-02-25
    amount: 100
    account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
    txn_guid: "c9f27c2b2f324117aa17c7c1f48fbafd"
